leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a function that accepts two strings as parameters to determine if they are anagrams.
Initialize a data structure to track character frequencies from the first string.
Manipulate the frequency data structure by iterating through the second string to adjust counts.
Apply a validation check to ensure all character frequencies return to zero.
Integrate edge-case handling for inputs of different lengths.
Implement the complete algorithm and return a boolean result.
